text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, as I'm passing by the gym...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's it! Let me hear those cheers!
Let all
that energy and passion burst out
from the
bottom of your hearts!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's what I'm talking about. ♪ Now
for the
next song! Let's gooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm met with the bizarre sight of Seeking
the Pearl
dancing onstage while
surrounded by an audience
of exuberant
students.

text_block_list.name: Younger Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Um... This is my first time coming to a
concert,
but I had such a good time
thanks to you!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, glad to hear it. Your smiles are
more
precious to me than any treasure in
the world.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You must've stumbled upon my solo
show on
accident, huh?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yep. I wanted to awaken the slumbering
passion
that's hidden within everyone's
hearts.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's why I hold these shows regularly.
It's all to
get everyone active and in
positive spirits!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You don't believe me? No worries, I
won't force
you to.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You can just sit back and let the music
carry you
away. Your spirits will be lifted
before you know
it.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
This next song will be my last, so let me
hear you
cheer like you mean it! Here I
go...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Mmm... Get ready for an exciting show!
